subject: Packrat cannot install BH 1.55.0-3 through RStudio

messages.author: 8611a3b4e639dc1c
messages.subject: Packrat cannot install BH 1.55.0-3 through RStudio
parts:
Installation fails with 

Installing BH (1.55.0-3) ... Error in download.file(url, destfile, method, mode = "wb", ...) : 
  cannot open URL 'http://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/BH_1.55.0-3.tgz'

The problem is that the sources are at http://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/BH_1.55.0-3.tar.gz (not .tgz).

CRAN has the correct information. Is RStudio caching an old version somewhere? Any other way to get around this problem?

Thanks,
Sim

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: Packrat cannot install BH 1.55.0-3 through RStudio
parts:
Hi Simeon,

This is an issue with packrat + the latest release of R (3.2.0) on OS X. In short, the default 'pkgType' option has changed to 'both', which the CRAN release of packrat unfortunately does not understand (and so constructs incorrect URLs when attempting to download package sources).

There are currently two workarounds:

1. Set `options(pkgType = "mac.binary.mavericks")` in your R session before running the associated packrat commands (and consider putting this into the project .Rprofile),
2. Install the latest version of packrat on GitHub (packrat::install_github('rstudio/packrat') and use that instead, as it should have a fixfor this issue.

We plan to submit a new version of packrat to CRAN within the next couple months and so this issue should be resolved then.

Thanks,
Kevin

parts:
That weird error is a consequence of the old layout of the packrat cache. You'll have to manually remove these packages (that is, their symlinks) with:

    file.remove(file.path(packrat:::libDir(), "packrat"))

After that, you should be able to re-install packrat.

Kevin
